Copies of an old art work called '''''Clone Wars Painting''''' were available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted the face of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A copy was rewarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] after the individual killed a ferocious [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] on the challenge of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter [[Qakkee]]. [[Ysith]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], also rewarded a copy of the painting to a spacer who helped [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Death/Legends|kill]] her rival, a fellow Trandoshan named [[Myssith]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The painting of Grievous appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. It was added to the game in [[2005]] as part of the [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] expansion pack as one of the many new quest rewards. The painting is specifically a reward from a part of the long chain of quests known collectively as the "Clone Relics" and part of the "Trandoshan Slavers" quest chain. It is named simply "Clone Wars Painting" in the game, a name it shares with a [[Clone Wars Painting (clone trooper)|similar painting]] of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]].<ref name="SWG" />
